_note: Run mechanics -- how a batch actually executes, independent of which league/decks. checkpoint_opponent_rate is the one field expected to be overridden per-invocation on purpose (e.g. a sub-league's planned 0.0 -> 0.20 switch at ~10k games/deck) rather than edited here. games_per_iteration is 12, not a smaller value like 2 (see todo/performance_investigation.md): at n_workers=6, gpi=2 only ever hands work to 2 of 6 workers (n_games // n_workers chunking), making mp6 measurably SLOWER than sequential (0.90x); gpi=12 lets all 6 get real, evenly-split work (1.69x). NOTE: this value is NOT what a `/train`-driven run actually uses -- the train skill (.claude/skills/train/SKILL.md) hardcodes its own games-per-iteration per batch and never reads this file; see that skill for the value that matters during real training.
